blocks.html: Are you curious about the recent webinar that UEMS Ventures conducted for the students of The Heartfulness Learning Centre? We’re excited to share the details with you!

The webinar was designed to provide career clarity and guidance to students in 9th and 10th grade, and was attended by parents and teachers as well. Our team at UEMS Ventures used the EVAL test, a scientifically validated career clarity test, to help students explore their interests and aptitudes, and guide them towards appropriate stream selection for higher education.

But we didn’t stop there. We wanted to make the webinar as engaging and interactive as possible, and we’re proud to say that the feedback we received from the participants was overwhelmingly positive. We used interactive tools and activities, such as group discussions and polls, to keep the students engaged and ensure that they were actively participating throughout the webinar.

blocks.html: The parents and teachers who attended the webinar also appreciated the valuable guidance that was provided to the students. It was a holistic learning experience that left everyone feeling more informed and empowered to make informed decisions about their future.

At UEMS Ventures, we are passionate about providing the right guidance and support to students. Our seminars and webinars are designed to be engaging, interactive, and informative, providing valuable insights and guidance to students and parents alike.
If you’re interested in learning more about our webinars and how we can help your educational institution, don’t hesitate to get in touch with us.
You can reach us on 9833808612 / 9321646670, or visit us at www.uemsventures.com to learn more. You can also drop us an email at [email protected].
We look forward to helping you and your students achieve their goals and succeed in their chosen careers!
